angleRead.name: Carmen Delaine
angleRead.text: Carmen's chasing the money trail on the West Oakland Stabilization Fund—where's it flowing, who's feeling it, and why do the neighborhood metrics still show decay despite two active mitigators? She's got that civic ledger itch, the kind that comes from watching too many initiatives turn into press releases without real impact. She'll start by hitting up service workers—they're the first to notice shifts in neighborhood vitality, and they don't sugarcoat.
